name: scan_pair_distances_and_update
description: Walks a table of index pairs and compares the difference between each pair's stored 16-bit values against a threshold. When a pair is close, it decrements a counter and a velocity-style word and updates a second word; otherwise it resets state and invokes three indirect handler calls.

name: seek_distant_pair_entry
description: Steps through the pair table, skipping entries whose stored difference is within a fixed bound, and returns once the scan count is exhausted. On a distant entry it re-enters the handler path that resets the state words and calls indirect handlers.

name: scan_pairs_for_close_entries
description: Iterates over the pair table, marking entries whose difference falls inside the threshold window and leaving others untouched. It runs a counter-decrement and reset branch when a close entry is found, and dispatches the indirect handlers only when the far-entry condition holds.

name: dispatch_pair_on_threshold_exceed
description: Resets the state words, invokes a shared helper routine and three indirect handler calls, then scans the pair table and breaks out when an entry's distance exceeds the limit. Otherwise it adjusts a counter and a speed-style word.

name: rebase_long_table_entries
description: Copies ten 32-bit values from a source table, subtracts a reference long from each, and adds the result to a paired base table to write the destination entries.

name: save_previous_sample_tables
description: Copies four saved tables forward by one step: two word tables of ten entries, one long table of ten entries, and one word table, so the current values become the previous sample.

name: rebuild_slot_index_table
description: Clears a 61-word table and, when a state word is set, scans nine range entries and writes each matching slot index into the table.

name: find_next_matching_slot
description: Walks the sorted slot values and, for each entry within a fixed window of the reference, records its slot index in a result table until the window is exhausted.

name: fill_slot_index_by_range
description: Scans a table of range entries and writes each entry's slot index into the output table whenever its value lies within the range bound of the reference.

name: shift_window_entries_if_enabled
description: When a state word is nonzero, shifts each of nine entries inside a 60-unit window by a delta, moving the value in one table down and adding it to the paired value in a second table.

name: shift_entries_in_window
description: Shifts each of nine entries that lies inside a 60-unit window by a delta, subtracting it from one table and adding it to the paired value in a second table.

name: apply_delta_to_window_entries
description: For each entry whose value lies within 60 units of the reference, subtracts a delta from one long table and adds it to the paired long of the second table. It skips entries outside the window and stops at the end of the list.

name: count_entries_past_base
description: Counts how many of nine entries are at or beyond a base value, offset by their paired distances, and stores that count in a global word.

name: extract_sorted_max_indices
description: Repeatedly finds the largest value in a ten-long table, clears that slot to a sentinel, and writes its index divided by four into an output word table for twenty output positions.

name: emit_next_larger_slot_index
description: Scans a ten-long table for values larger than the previous one and writes each entry's index divided by four into an output table, stopping after twenty outputs.

name: call_two_indirect_handlers
description: Invokes two handler pointers stored in the state block in sequence, with no arguments and no result.

name: stub_empty_sign_test
description: Tests a 16-bit register for a positive value but performs no action on either branch, so the routine has no effect.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without any work, so the routine is an empty stub.

name: invoke_handler_then_chain
description: Calls one indirect handler from the state block and then calls the routine at the start of this block.

name: format_timer_into_text_buffer
description: Splits a tenths-of-a-second count into tenths, seconds and minutes fields stored in the state block, then writes separator and unit characters into a short text buffer.

name: format_timer_alternate_entry
description: Splits a tenths-of-a-second count into tenths, seconds and minutes fields stored in the state block, then writes separator and unit characters into a short text buffer. It is an alternate entry into the same formatting code.

name: write_two_digit_ascii
description: Writes the tens and units digits of the input value as two ASCII characters into a buffer, with the tens digit first.

name: call_library_functions_in_sequence
description: Loads a library base from the state block, calls one library function on it, runs a helper routine, then calls a second library function on the same base.

name: walk_node_list_with_library
description: Walks a linked list once calling a library function on each node, then walks it again clearing two node fields, calling another library function, and restoring those fields.

name: allocate_record_with_entries
description: Allocates a 44-byte record and two sub-buffers through library allocation calls, stores the word parameters in the record, and fills an array of entries with values computed from the two parameters. It returns the record, or zero if an allocation fails.

name: free_record_and_buffers
description: Frees each item of a list held by the record, then frees the list header, the second sub-buffer and the record itself. It calls a library cleanup function first and another one when a stored pointer is present.

name: free_record_buffers_from_register
description: Performs the same freeing sequence as the record cleanup routine, taking the record pointer from the incoming register instead of the stack.

name: initialize_sound_interrupt_server
description: Clears a three-entry table of 30-byte channel records, then writes the audio interrupt and DMA control registers and installs the sound interrupt handler. Progress is reported through debug messages that name the interrupt server.

name: call_helper_if_nonnull
description: Returns minus one when the input pointer is null. Otherwise it calls a helper routine and returns zero.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns the constant minus one and performs no other work.

name: poll_cia_status_until_ready
description: Loops until either a state byte or a CIA-mapped global byte becomes non-negative, then returns the incoming register value.

name: clear_flags_and_delay
description: Clears two state flags, calls a helper, calls the DOS library Delay function, and then clears a third flag.

name: call_helper_then_clear_flags
description: Calls a helper routine and then clears two state flags.

name: enable_interrupt_channel_record
description: When the state word is zero and a pointer is supplied, selects a channel index through helper calls, sets that channel's interrupt-enable bit, and fills the channel's 30-byte record with the pointer, a flag word and a sentinel value.

name: poll_helper_until_zero
description: Calls a helper routine repeatedly until it returns zero.

name: kill_audio_channel
description: Stops one of four audio channels by clearing its volume, setting its period to a fixed value and clearing its DMA bit. It also clears the channel's 30-byte record and a state flag when the channel is the second one.

name: kill_audio_channel_checked
description: Reports an illegal channel number through a helper when the index is above three, then performs the same clearing as the channel kill routine. The error text names the KillSfxChannel call.

name: kill_audio_channel_guarded
description: Calls a helper when the channel index is above three, then performs the same channel clearing as the channel kill routine.

name: kill_audio_channel_error_report
description: Reports a channel number that is too large through a helper call, then performs the same channel clearing as the channel kill routine without a range check.

name: clear_audio_channel_state
description: Clears the channel record and audio registers for one of four channels without calling helpers, and clears a state flag when the channel is the second one.

name: check_channel_record_busy
description: Returns minus one when the channel record's first word is nonzero, and zero otherwise.

name: set_audio_channel_period_volume
description: When the period argument is nonnegative, writes it to the audio channel period register. When the volume argument is nonnegative, stores a sentinel in the channel record and writes the volume to the audio channel volume register.

name: store_channel_record_fields
description: Stores the first argument into a channel record field and writes the second argument, shifted into the upper half of a long, into the adjacent record field.

name: service_audio_channel_records
description: Checks the four audio channel records against the active DMA bits. For each active channel it either counts a timer down or resets the record, then writes the combined channel mask to the audio DMA and interrupt control registers.

name: update_audio_channel_hardware
description: Advances a shared frame counter, copies the pending location, length and volume words of each ready channel into the audio hardware block, and steps each channel's position toward its target. It then writes the DMA enable mask.

name: acquire_resource_chain
description: Calls nine helper routines in order and stores the first two results in the record. It returns the last helper result when the stored values are nonzero, and minus one otherwise.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: clamp_negated_value_to_limit
description: Negates a stored word and returns it when it lies from zero up to twenty thousand four hundred and seventy nine. Otherwise it returns twenty thousand four hundred and eighty.

name: return_handler_code_pointer
description: Returns a code pointer to a routine in this block.

name: call_five_helpers_in_order
description: Calls five helper routines in sequence, one of which invokes a library function through a base pointer, and returns nothing.

name: store_fixed_offset_global
description: Stores a fixed negative constant into a global word and returns the incoming register value.

name: poll_helpers_until_flag_clear
description: Repeatedly calls helper routines and returns minus one if one of them reports failure. It sets a record byte to a fixed value and loops while a flag stays set, then returns the last helper result.

name: call_library_function_directly
description: Calls one library function on a base pointer held in the state block, then calls a helper routine.

name: close_handle_and_return_result
description: Sets a result field to minus one, obtains a handle through a library call, and when the handle exists calls two of its methods and a library close routine. It then returns the stored result.

name: open_library_and_release
description: Sets a result field to minus one, opens the dos.library name through the exec base, and when the open succeeds calls two methods on the returned base before closing it. It returns the stored result.

name: open_trackdisk_device_request
description: Fills a device request record with a unit value and a fixed length, then calls a library function to open the trackdisk.device.

name: store_two_library_results
description: Calls two library functions and stores their results in the state record and a second record, one as a long and one as a byte.

name: call_library_then_helper
description: Calls one library function on the base pointer held in the state block, then calls a helper routine.

name: send_device_request_command
description: Stores a helper result and fixed command and length fields into a device request, calls a library function to send it, and returns minus one.

name: send_device_request_computed
description: Computes a length from three register values, stores it with fixed command fields into a device request, calls a library function to send it, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_computed
description: Builds a disk request record with command code three and a length computed from three register values, adds a fixed offset and the caller's fields, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_scaled_length
description: Builds a disk request with command code ten and a length scaled from one register value, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_code_six
description: Builds a disk request with command code six from the caller's register values, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_code_thirteen
description: Builds a disk request with command code thirteen from the caller's register values, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_nine_once
description: Builds a disk request with command code nine and a fixed unit value of one, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: queue_disk_request_zero_offset
description: Builds a disk request with command code nine and a zero offset, sends it through a library call, and returns minus one.

name: register_disk_resource_handler
description: Obtains the disk.resource pointer through a library call and stores it in the state record, together with a fixed value and a code pointer to the handler.

name: wait_disk_ready_then_enable
description: Loops calling a disk resource check until it reports ready, polling a second function between checks. It then writes fixed control words to the DMA and audio control registers.

name: invoke_disk_resource_routine
description: Calls one function on the disk resource base held in the state block.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Writes a fixed disk length value followed by the DMA enable bit to the disk control registers, then calls a library function on the disk resource base.

name: stub_return_without_work
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: update_flag_byte_bits
description: Clears the bit selected by the first register value in a state byte, then sets bit two when the second register value is zero.

name: copy_state_byte_to_register
description: Copies a state byte into a control word and writes a fixed flag value to a second control word.

name: start_disk_sync_transfer
description: Calls a helper, waits for a countdown to run out, then writes the DMA control, disk pointer and sync words to the custom chip registers. It finishes by calling two helper routines.

name: set_top_bit_field
description: Stores the incoming value with its top bit set into a 16-bit field of the record addressed by the second register, twice.

name: reset_record_and_call_library
description: Sets a state word to a fixed value, sets a second word to two, and calls a library function on the base pointer.

name: find_disk_sync_marker_offset
description: Decodes a track number from two register-held longs and returns minus one when it does not match the expected value. Otherwise it scans up to a thousand words of a buffer for the disk sync marker and returns the number of words read before it.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: compute_bitwise_checksum
description: Computes a 16-bit checksum over a run of words by shifting each bit through the accumulator and exclusive-ORing with a feedback value when the top bit is set.

name: call_helper_with_fixed_pair
description: Calls one helper routine with the incoming argument and a fixed packed pair of values.

name: call_helper_with_pair_three
description: Calls one helper routine with the incoming argument and a fixed packed pair of values, the second value being three.

name: load_and_decode_file
description: Opens a named file through the dos library, examines its length and allocates a buffer for it, then reads the contents. When the header tag matches, it decodes the packed payload through helper routines, otherwise it keeps the raw data, and it releases its handles before returning the stored result.

name: read_record_field_eight
description: Returns the 32-bit field stored at offset eight of the record passed in the argument.

name: dispatch_record_by_code
description: Initializes decoder state from the record, then handles its data according to the record code. Codes two and three read and process symbols until the end of data, code four runs a helper before doing so, and code eight runs one helper once.

name: process_values_until_sentinel
description: Reads values in a loop and processes each one, stopping when the read returns minus one.

name: stub_no_operation_entry
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: forward_to_single_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: read_pair_table_from_stream
description: Reads a count from the input stream and returns minus one when it exceeds 256. Otherwise it fills a table of that many entries, reading two values for each entry, and returns the count.

name: fill_pair_table_from_stream
description: Sets the first entry of a pair table to a sentinel value, then reads a count of pairs from the input stream into the table.

name: read_pair_entries_into_table
description: Reads pairs of values from the input stream into the table, one pair per index, until the stored count is reached.

name: read_little_endian_word
description: Reads two values from the input stream and combines them into one 16-bit word, with the second value in the high byte.

name: decode_escaped_run_length
description: Decodes a byte stream in two states. Ordinary bytes pass through, while the escape value starts a repeat state that reads a count and emits the following symbol that many times.

name: read_next_buffer_byte
description: Returns the next byte from the buffer while the remaining count is positive, and minus one once the buffer is exhausted.

name: write_next_buffer_byte
description: Stores the incoming byte at the buffer position when the write counter is below its limit, then advances the position.

name: decode_dictionary_compressed_stream
description: Checks the code-size header, resets a 256-entry dictionary of single bytes, and then decodes variable-width codes into output bytes while extending the dictionary as it goes.

name: read_variable_width_code
description: Returns the next variable-width code from the packed input, adjusting the number of bits per code as the code counter advances. It returns minus one when the stream is exhausted.

name: allocate_decoder_work_buffer
description: Allocates a work buffer on first use and sets up the table and output pointers inside it.

name: free_decoder_work_buffer
description: Frees the work buffer when one is allocated and clears its pointer.

name: call_helper_with_pair_one
description: Calls one helper routine with the incoming argument and a fixed packed pair of values, the second value being one.

name: load_file_into_buffer
description: Opens a named file through the dos library, reads it into an allocated buffer, and decodes it through a helper when no explicit size is given. It then releases temporary handles and returns the buffer pointer.

name: call_helper_with_zero_third
description: Calls one helper routine with the two incoming arguments and a zero third argument, then returns.

name: call_helper_with_zero_second
description: Calls one helper routine with the first and third incoming arguments and a zero second argument, then returns.

name: step_pseudo_random_word
description: Advances a 16-bit state word with a multiply, add and exclusive-OR step that mixes in a hardware-sourced global byte, producing the next pseudo-random value.

name: unpack_packbits_stream
description: Unpacks a PackBits-style run-length stream from a source pointer into a destination pointer for a given byte count. Control bytes either copy literal bytes or repeat the next byte, and both pointers are written back on return.

name: unpack_packbits_entry
description: Performs the same PackBits-style unpacking as the stream routine, taking the source pointer, destination pointer and remaining count from registers.

name: clear_high_bit_global
description: Clears the top bit of a global byte that is mapped to the CIA chip.

name: store_helper_result_word
description: Calls a helper routine and stores its 16-bit result in a state word.

name: store_helper_result_second_word
description: Calls a helper routine and stores its 16-bit result in a second state word.

name: store_two_helper_results
description: Calls two helper routines and stores each 16-bit result in its own state word.

name: check_fire_button_pressed
description: Returns one when either of two active-low button bits in the port byte is clear, and zero otherwise.

name: select_joystick_direction_entry
description: Builds a four-bit index from two bits at each end of the joystick port byte, then calls the handler selected from a dispatch table and returns the incoming register value.

name: set_flag_bit_and_mark
description: Sets one bit in a flag byte array and copies a table entry into the output. When the bit was previously clear and the helper reports success, it writes a sentinel word into the record.

name: forward_helper_result
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value it leaves in the address register.

name: find_table_entry_by_key
description: Searches a table of ascending 32-bit keys for the incoming key and returns the address of the matching entry's payload, or zero when the key is absent.

name: return_stacked_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without modifying it.

name: swap_state_word_value
description: Stores the incoming value in a state word and returns the word's previous value.

name: initialize_io_request_resources
description: Stores a parameter and a count of ten, creates I/O request blocks through library calls, links them to the state block and a handler pointer, and records the resulting request pointer.

name: release_io_request_resources
description: When the stored request pointer is non-null, sends the release requests through helper routines and then clears the pointer.

name: close_io_request_resources
description: Sends the close requests for the stored I/O request blocks through a library function and helper routines, then clears the pointer without checking it first.

name: chain_helper_results
description: Calls one helper routine and passes its result to a second helper routine.

name: read_single_byte_via_library
description: Reads one byte through a library call into a local buffer and returns it when the read count is one, otherwise returns zero.

name: queue_keyboard_event
description: Handles raw keyboard events. For press events it appends the key code and the following word to a bounded queue when the queue has room, and it clears a state byte after each event that is consumed.

name: check_pending_count_nonzero
description: Returns minus one when the pending count word is nonzero, and zero otherwise.

name: pop_queued_event
description: Removes the front entry of the event queue by shifting the remaining entries down one place and decrementing the count. It returns the entry's code and value, with the value inverted under a mask when a global word is set.

name: pop_queued_event_entry
description: Performs the same queue removal as the pop routine, without the conditional handling of the global word.

name: forward_helper_with_pair_one
description: Calls one helper routine with the first incoming argument, a fixed packed pair of values with the second value one, and a third argument from the stack.

name: forward_helper_with_pair_three
description: Calls one helper routine with the first incoming argument and a fixed packed pair of values with the second value three.

name: allocate_and_link_list_node
description: Allocates a node from a pool and inserts it into a circular list held in the state block. It returns the address of the node's payload, or zero when allocation fails.

name: unlink_and_free_list_node
description: When the argument is minus one, frees every node in the state list. Otherwise it unlinks the given node from its neighbours and frees it.

name: return_previous_node_address
description: Returns the link pointer found before the given record, adjusted back by twelve bytes.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: clip_span_to_window
description: Computes clipped screen coordinates for a sixteen-pixel span from an input record. It adjusts the source and destination pointers and an offset table at the clip boundaries, then stores the resulting position and word count in the state block.

name: clip_span_to_window_entry
description: Performs the same span clipping as the window clip routine, taking the source position from registers instead of the input record.

name: stub_returns_at_once
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: call_helper_then_indirect
description: Calls one helper routine, then calls a second routine through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered, and returns.

name: queue_span_blit_operations
description: Reads the span record and builds blitter control words from its position and bitmask. It waits for the blitter to become idle, writes the source, destination and modulus values, then loops over the bitplane masks to queue a blit for each set plane.

name: return_stacked_long
description: Returns the 64-bit value passed on the stack without changing it.

name: store_and_check_helper_result
description: Stores the incoming value in a state long, calls one helper routine with it, and keeps the helper's result in a second state long. It clears the first long when the result is zero.

name: call_indirect_routines_in_order
description: Calls an indirect routine from the state block, then calls one helper routine, then calls a second indirect routine from the state block.

name: or_combine_bitplane_rows
description: For a source record, OR-combines between one and four bitplane rows into the destination buffer, with the plane count selected by a stored value. It then computes blitter control values and calls helper routines.

name: or_combine_bitplane_rows_alt
description: Alternate entry to the bitplane OR-combine routine. It reads the source position from the record at a later offset, combines up to four rows into the destination, then waits for the blitter to become idle and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_combine_plane_rows_counted
description: Combines source rows with OR into the destination, with the number of rows chosen by a plane count argument. It then waits for the blitter to become idle, writes its registers and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_two_bitplane_rows
description: ORs two source rows word by word into the destination row, then waits for the blitter to become idle, writes its registers and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_three_bitplane_rows
description: ORs three source rows word by word into the destination row, with an odd leading word handled first, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_three_bitplane_rows_plain
description: ORs three source rows word by word into the destination row without a leading odd word, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_four_bitplane_rows
description: ORs four source rows word by word into the destination row, with an odd leading word handled first, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_four_bitplane_rows_plain
description: ORs four source rows word by word into the destination row without a leading odd word, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_five_plane_rows_odd
description: ORs five source rows word by word into the destination row with an odd leading word handled first, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: or_five_plane_rows_plain
description: ORs five source rows word by word into the destination row without a leading odd word, then waits for the blitter and queues blits for each set plane.

name: call_indirect_then_jump
description: Calls an indirect routine from the state block, then calls a second routine through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered, and returns.

name: call_indirect_and_return_input
description: Calls one routine through an indirect pointer in the state block and returns the incoming register value unchanged.

name: call_indirect_helper_then_jump
description: Calls an indirect routine from the state block, then calls a helper routine, then calls a second routine through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered.

name: queue_span_blits_with_fallback
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, selects a source word with a fallback value, computes blitter control words from the span coordinates in the state block, and queues a blit for each set plane.

name: return_unchanged_stack_long
description: Returns the 64-bit value passed on the stack without changing it.

name: call_indirect_helper_chain
description: Calls an indirect routine, then a helper routine, then a second indirect routine through a jump whose target could not be recovered, and returns.

name: set_blit_registers_for_span
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, clears its position fields, stores the source and destination values and a control word chosen by whether a source is present, then returns.

name: call_indirect_helper_sequence
description: Calls an indirect routine, then a helper routine, then a second indirect routine through a jump whose target could not be recovered.

name: queue_clipped_span_rows
description: Clamps a rectangle to the window bounds held in the state block, then for each row of the clipped area writes a blit descriptor with computed source and destination offsets and a control word.

name: check_task_changed
description: Calls the exec FindTask function and returns one when the current task differs from the stored task pointer, and zero when they match.

name: store_current_task_pointer
description: Calls the exec FindTask function and stores the returned current task pointer in the state block.

name: load_bitmap_header_state
description: Stores the pointer to a bitmap header in the state block, copies the header's data table into state, and sets the header's mask byte from its plane count.

name: load_bitmap_header_from_register
description: Performs the same bitmap header load as the header routine, taking the header pointer from an incoming register instead of the stack.

name: call_helper_keep_registers
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the incoming register pair unchanged.

name: set_clip_rectangle_bounds
description: Stores four clip rectangle bounds in the state block, aligns the two origin values down to sixteen-pixel multiples, and records exclusive limits one less than the stored edges.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Loops until the blitter busy flag clears, then calls a helper routine.

name: call_indirect_then_helper_branch
description: Calls an indirect routine from the state block, then a helper routine, then a second routine through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered.

name: clip_edge_span_against_rect
description: Clips a span against the clip rectangle in the state block, updates the edge values for each boundary crossed, and computes the flags and blit values for the clipped span.

name: interpolate_edge_across_clip
description: Steps an edge across the clip rectangle by interpolating its horizontal and vertical values with a fixed-point slope for each boundary it crosses.

name: step_edge_toward_clip_limit
description: Moves an edge toward a clip limit by interpolating its coordinates with a fixed-point slope, then selects the next boundary to test.

name: step_edge_with_clip_flags
description: Steps an edge while testing its position against the clip limits selected by a flag word. It interpolates the coordinates across each boundary crossed and writes the clipped values for the next stage.

name: interpolate_edge_by_clip_flags
description: Interpolates the edge coordinates across each clip boundary indicated by the flag word, and writes the clipped coordinates and the blit values for the next stage.

name: interpolate_edge_low_flags
description: Interpolates edge coordinates across the clip boundaries indicated by the lower flag bits, and writes the clipped values for the next stage.

name: interpolate_edge_two_flags
description: Interpolates edge coordinates across the clip boundaries indicated by two flag bits, and writes the clipped values for the next stage.

name: interpolate_edge_single_flag
description: Interpolates edge coordinates across a single clip boundary when its flag bit is set, and writes the clipped values for the next stage.

name: setup_line_draw_parameters
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two endpoints, selects the major axis and an octant code from a lookup table, and writes the slope, start address and word count into the output record.

name: write_span_records
description: For each span in a list, waits for the blitter to become idle, writes its control and start values, and computes a width and modulus from the span endpoints into one record per span.

name: return_argument_unchanged
description: Returns the argument passed in unchanged.

name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: plot_pixel_across_bitplanes
description: When the coordinates fall inside the clip rectangle, computes a byte offset and sets or clears one bit in each bitplane according to the matching bit of the plane mask.

name: set_plane_bits_at_offset
description: For each flag bit in a word, sets or clears one bit at a common bit position in the matching bitplane, using the plane pointers in a table at the given offset.

name: update_plane_bit_run
description: Walks a run of plane pointers and sets or clears one bit in each bitplane at the given offset, according to successive flag bits.

name: print_string_raw_output
description: Writes each character of a zero-terminated string through the exec serial output routine, then returns zero.

name: stub_no_operation_routine
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: forward_to_formatted_output
description: Calls one formatted-output helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: call_formatted_output_helper
description: Calls the formatted-output helper routine and returns with no other work.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer until a zero byte is copied, including the terminator. It returns the original destination pointer.

name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string and returns the number of bytes before the terminator. It does not modify memory.

name: parse_signed_decimal_word
description: Skips leading spaces and tabs, reads an optional sign, then accumulates decimal digits into a 16-bit value. The result is negated when the sign was minus.

name: parse_signed_decimal_digits
description: Reads an optional sign and then accumulates decimal digits into a 16-bit value, negating it when the sign was minus.

name: parse_decimal_with_flag
description: Skips an optional plus sign, accumulates decimal digits into a 16-bit value, and negates the result when the flag register is nonzero.

name: accumulate_decimal_digits
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the current string position into a 16-bit value and negates the result when the flag register is nonzero.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately.

name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Clears a block of state words, stores the exec base pointer, and opens the dos.library through the exec library. When the open fails it raises an alert, otherwise it continues with the rest of the initialization.

name: stub_return_empty_frame
description: Returns immediately without performing any work.

name: setup_dos_process_context
description: Allocates a context block sized from a stored count and initializes its fields. It then looks up the dos input, output and current directory, opens a stream through the dos library wrappers, and records the handles it obtained.

name: build_string_pointer_table
description: Allocates a block, copies byte-coded entries from a table into it, and builds a list of pointers to the null-terminated strings in the table.

name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most just under thirty-two thousand bytes and writing a terminator when the copy is cut short.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to a destination string for up to a count of bytes. If the count expires before the source terminator, it writes a null terminator after the copied bytes.

name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination up to a count or until a null terminator is found, then fills any remaining bytes of the count with zeros.
